title: Positive Expectations & Microdosing | Microdosinginstitute
abstract:
## Introduction  
This prospective survey study included 81 participants and investigated the effects of psychedelic microdosing on mental health outcomes. The key focus was on how positive expectations could shape the perceived benefits of microdosing, specifically concerning state anxiety and depressive symptoms over a four-week period.
## Conclusion  
In conclusion, this study offers initial evidence of the importance of positive expectancies in predicting mental health outcomes associated with psychedelic microdosing. The researchers advocate for further exploration into the intricate relationship between expectations and pharmacological effects to enhance the understanding of microdosing’s role in mental health treatments.
### Positive expectations predict improved mental-health outcomes linked to psychedelic microdosing
